name: fxf_truce_office
doc: The Truce ticket office (loc 012) at storyline 3 with 600 G: the ROM's own loader (--teleport 18 7 58 0, method jmp, 240 frames) from the recipe-made 1000 A.D. overworld by Truce (truce_market), so the office is entered from the world ($0105 = 01F0) as in the ferry references; Crono walks up to the counter below the clerk (obj 8). NOT YET USED: A at the counter where the ferry captures stood starts no talk with the clerk on this state (nor on one entered from the world map), so saves/ferry_re/* stay the captures for now.
